description:
The Slovenian Table Hockey Federation welcomes all players to the 20th installment of Slovenia Open, the biggest annual table hockey tournament in Slovenia and part of the ITHF World Tour 2026/2027, this year as a Super Series tournament. The event will be held on Saturday, 10th of October 2026, at Franceta Prešerna Elementary School in Kranj (Kidričeva cesta 49, 4000 Kranj).

Registration: namiznihokej@gmail.com

Participation fee: 20 € (15 € for juniors)

Schedule:
8:00 - Doors open
9:45 - End of registration
10:15 - Basic groups
12:00 - Lunch
13:00 - Final groups
16:00 - Play-off
20:30 - Award Ceremony
21:30 - Afterparty (Klub študentov Kranj, Slovenski trg 5, 4000 Kranj)

Playing system:
6 basic groups with ~13 players in each group (1-9 advance to final group, the rest to Division 2)
2 final groups with 27 players each
Division 2 with all remaining players (play-off for top 4 players, best of 5)
Play-off for best 32 players (16 from each final group), best of 7 (bronze medal match best of 5)

Results from basic groups are carried over only for mutual matches between players advancing to the final groups. Results for Division 2 are not carried over.

Lunch:
Price of each meal is 10 €. Pre-ordered meals will be delivered to the tournament venue during the main break (~12:00).

Live stream:
Basic groups: https://www.youtube.com/live/KAg_3mNwjho
Final groups and play-off: https://www.youtube.com/live/nQeNkzdXZbo
name: Slovenia Open 2026 (Super Series)
